explication: CloakBrowser Manager is a self-hosted browser-profile manager: users organize isolated browser identities, configure per-profile fingerprint, network, locale, and compatibility options, then launch, view, and automate those sessions. The React UI calls a FastAPI service; the service coordinates profile persistence and browser lifecycle, with Linux sessions additionally served through KasmVNC and the web viewer. Settings and status expose licensing and runtime information. README-documented capabilities are included where their implementation is not shown; edges are limited to wiring supported by the sampled source.
